question: Iberian Peninsula can be found in which of the following continents?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Europe.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Iberian Peninsula is a peninsula in southwestern Europe, occupied by Spain and Portugal.**
 
• The Iberian Peninsula is** located on Europe's southwestern tip.**
 
• It is** part of the southern Europe peninsula,** which comprises** three peninsulas; Iberian, Balkan, and Italian peninsulas.**
 
• The Iberian is the **westernmost peninsula of the three peninsulas.**
 
• The** largest country **which is part of the Iberian Peninsula in **Spain**, which **makes up about 79% of the peninsula.**
 
• The other countries part of this region is **Portugal, France, Andorra, and Gibraltar.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**
